title: Kadhale En Kadhale
desc: Kritika loves Rajiv but fails to tell him. He loves Pragati, but she refuses him. A few years later, Rajiv's marriage is fixed and the girl turns out to be Pragati. Then Pragati learns about Kritika

title: Style
desc: Four college friends try to help two lovers get married against the wishes of their parents. The attempts of the youngsters lead to hilarious consequences.

title: Raajakumaran
desc: Both Vaidehi and Selvi, who happen to be Rajakumaran's cousins, are in love with him. When Vaidehi decides to commit suicide, Rajakumaran is left heartbroken.

title: Niyabagal Thalattum
desc: Abhiram meets Nandini and falls for her. But, he has no clue to her whereabouts. While visiting a family friend's house for a wedding, he realises that the bride-to-be is none other than Nandini.

title: Naan Rajavaaga Pogiren
desc: Jeeva, who leads a good life in Himachal Pradesh, learns that he has a lookalike, Raja, who is a boxer in Chennai. Intrigued by the notion, Jeeva sets out on an adventurous journey to find Raja.

title: Vanmam
desc: Friends Radha and Chelladurai lead a carefree life. When Radha accidentally kills Chelladurai's brother-in-law, it turns them bitter foes, and a cunning man uses their enmity to his benefits

title: Dummy Tappasu
desc: An obese man, living in the slums of Chennai, comes across a series of situations that change his perception towards life and love.

title: Edhyathai Thirudathey
desc: Prakash, who is diagnosed with terminal cancer, and Geethanjali, an equally ill patient, fall in love with each other. However, when she learns about his illness, she decides to move out of his life.

title: Iniyavaley
desc: Prabhakar is firm on marrying only after he clears his exams and becomes a collector. When his parents fix his marriage, his protests lead to complications and he ends up marrying the bride's sister.

title: Amma Appa Cheliam
desc: Chellam, a boy from a poor family, is in love with a rich girl but ignores her by focusing on his career while making his parents proud by scoring the highest in the district.

title: Cheran Chozhan Pandian
desc: After being released from jail Cheran, Chozhan, and Pandian are determined to reform, they encounter the corrupt politician Swamy. They befriend Gayathri, Swamy's sister, leading to complications.

title: Duet
desc: Two musician brothers, Guna and Siva, end up falling in love with Anjali, a choreographer. However, the brothers have a rift when Siva becomes possessive of Anjali.

title: Pandiyan
desc: Pandiyan, a police officer, is enraged when his sister's husband dies. In order to find and catch the culprits, he goes undercover

title: Iravum Pagalum Varu
desc: Karthi, a college student, indulges in petty thieving. But his life changes when a corrupt police officer decides to use him for performing illegal activities.

title: Nageswary
desc: A night before her wedding, Nagaveni and her brother are assaulted and killed by her fiance, Eashwar, and his friends. However, she rises from the dead and sets out to take revenge on them.

title: Gummalam
desc: Four friends fall in love with Rathi when she moves in into their neighbour's house. Later, the police arrest her and they all get shocked to learn about her true identity.

title: Parthen Rasithen
desc: Shankar, a graduate, awaits recruitment and lives as a tenant with Bhanu who seeks his company to stay away from her stepbrother. Meanwhile, Shankar begins to fall in love with Sarika.

title: Roja
desc: Roja, a simple girl from a village in Tamil Nadu, makes desperate efforts to find her husband, Rishi, after he is kidnapped by militants during a secret undercover mission in Jammu and Kashmir.
